ONGOING

Fort Myers Farmers Market – Fresh foods farmers market every Saturday from 9 a.m. – 1 p.m. at Downtown Fort Myers’ First Street & Broadway. The Fort Myers Farmers Market returns all summer, bringing fresh local produce, seafood, baked goods, flowers, crafts and more to downtown. 2200 First Street, Fort Myers. 239-321-7000 or fortmyers.gov.

Ping Pong Power – Community wellness program at Estero Recreation Center every Saturday at 2 p.m. Weekly table tennis sessions for seniors, individuals with Parkinson's, Alzheimer's, dementia, MS or memory challenges, and caregivers promote fun, fitness, and friendship while improving focus, reflexes, balance, and coordination. 9200 Corkscrew Palms Blvd., Estero. 239-272-8941.

Dear Evan Hansen – Theatrical performance at Arts Bonita’s Hinman Auditorium available Oct. 2-11 with multiple showtimes. An emotional, award-winning musical about connection, belonging, and the consequences of a teen’s lies after a community tragedy. Tickets start at $24.00. 10150 Bonita Beach Road, Bonita Springs. 239-495-8989 or artsbonita.org.

Mean Girls – Theatrical performance at The Belle Theatre available Oct. 2-17 with multiple showtimes. Get ready for a fetch night of sharp comedy, catchy songs, and high-school drama as “Mean Girls” brings its iconic story of friendship and confidence. Tickets start at $25.00. 2708 Santa Barbara Blvd. #135, Cape Coral. 239-323-5533 or thebelletheatre.com.

Art Walk: Dark Art – Art exhibit on display at Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center available Oct 2-15. Explore bold, haunting, and unconventional works that transform fear, grief, resilience, and imagination into unforgettable visual art. 2301 First Street, Fort Myers. 239-333-1933 or sbdac.com.

Intro to Photography – Photography course at Sidney & Berne Davis Art Center through Oct. 15, Thursdays at 6 p.m. Train your eye before your camera in this hands-on 8-week photography course, where light, composition, and creative confidence come first. Tickets are $375.00. 2301 First Street, Fort Myers. 239-333-1933 or sbdac.com.

Currents – Collaborative art mural at Big Arts Sanibel Island available for viewing through Oct. 30. Currents turns Big Arts’ Dunham Gallery into 6 x 125 feet living underwater mural, created collaboratively by six local artists over 3 months. 900 Dunlop Road, Sanibel. 239-395-0900 or bigarts.org.

Faces, Places, and Spaces Art Exhibit – Art exhibition at Sanibel Public Library through Nov. 2. Summer showcase featuring works by Sanibel-Captiva Art League artists with pieces available for purchase. Admission is free. 770 Dunlop Rd., Sanibel. sancapart.org.

Klaus NOMI & Kenny SCHARF: Time SPLAT! – Art exhibition at Bob Rauschenberg Gallery Annex available through Dec. 5 with gallery open 10 a.m. – 4 p.m. Enter a vivid collision of Pop Surrealism, New Wave, and operatic futurism through art, costumes, artifacts, and rare performance archives. 8099 College Parkway, Bldg. J – Library Lobby (1st Floor / J-118), Fort Myers. 239-489-9313 or rauschenberggallery.com.

Peter Massing and Selections from the Permanent Collection – Art exhibition at Wilson G. Bradshaw Library, FGCU through Dec. 4. Explore prints and works from the permanent collection featuring artist Peter Massing. 10501 FGCU Blvd. S., Fort Myers. 239-590-7199 or fgcu.edu.

Between Creation & Concrete: Collaborative Window Installation by Breah Fyffe and Marcela Pulgarin – Art installation at FGCU Arts Complex Lobby Windows through July 14, 2027. Explore a nature-inspired window installation blending organic imagery, drawing and vinyl artwork. 10501 FGCU Blvd. S., Fort Myers. 239-590-7199 or fgcu.edu.

Color and Shapes – Fine arts exhibition at BIG ARTS Sanibel through Feb. 7. Explore a collaborative mural inspired by the works of Piet Mondrian, Henri Matisse, Sonia and Robert Delaunay, and Jean Arp. 900 Dunlop Road, Sanibel. 239-395-0900 or bigarts.org.

Counterparts: The Art of Roland Ruocco and Wendy White – Art exhibition at DAAS CO-OP Art Gallery & Gifts through the month of September. Explore new works by two Southwest Florida artists during the opening reception. 10051 McGregor Blvd., Suite 104, Fort Myers. 239-955-0422 or daascoop.com.

Forever Everly: The Everly Brothers Rockumentary – Live musical at Florida Rep’s Artstage Studio Theatre through Oct. 25 with multiple showtimes. Murder On My Mind – Murder mystery dinner train at Seminole Gulf Railway through Oct. 28. Solve a murder mystery while enjoying a five-course dinner aboard a 3½-hour train ride. Tickets are $129.00. 2805 Colonial Blvd., Fort Myers. 239-275-8487 or semgulf.com.
